Admissions.title: Iraq University Admissions Checker
Admissions.subtitle: No login required. Enter your baccalaureate average to see departments where the latest cutoff was at or below your score.
Admissions.indicativeNotice: Indicative only — past cutoffs are not a guarantee of admission. Always verify on the official MOHESR or KRG Zankoline portals.
Admissions.explainerTitle: How Federal (MOHESR) vs. KRG (Zankoline) Admissions Work
Admissions.explainerFederal: Federal Central Admission (MOHESR): uses your competitive average (total ÷ 7, which can exceed 100 with foreign-language bonuses). Published officially each autumn at dirasat.mohesr.gov.iq.
Admissions.explainerKrg: KRG Zankoline: uses a weighted composite score. Because Zankoline does not publish an official table, KRG cutoffs always carry Medium or Low confidence labels from university and student-union reports.
Admissions.includeReach: Also show close reach (up to +2 points above average)
Admissions.emptyResults: No departments match your current average and filters. Try adjusting filters or importing cutoffs via the Editor Console.
